subject: Onboarding milestone schedule and early-sign credit
messages:
From: Alex Mason <alex@nimbleware.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: demo + MAP framework

Jonas,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the low-latency behavior on the retrieval pipeline is exactly what our engineering team was looking for. We want to move from eval -> production over the next quarter, but need to lock down a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a concrete commit/ramp schedule tied to pricing and credits.

Top-level asks from our side: 
- 6-week evaluation window with a clear acceptance checklist (latency P95, throughput profile, and quality checks against our benchmark prompts)
- A staged monthly commitment (tokens/month) that lets us start small and scale rapidly if the evaluation passes
- Discounts or credits tied to commit thresholds and an early-signing credit if we execute the MAP within 2 weeks of the SOW

Could you send a draft MAP with proposed monthly TPM targets and the discount breakpoints? Procurement (cc'd later) will need the SOW and an invoice cadence for internal review.

Best,
Alex
Alex Mason | Head of AI, NimbleWare
alex@nimbleware.com

---
Attachment: none in this initial note

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mason <alex@nimbleware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + MAP framework

Alex — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks. I attached an initial draft MAP that aligns with what you described. High-level summary below; details and acceptance criteria are in Draft_MAP_NimbleWare_v1.pdf (attached).

Proposed evaluation and ramp (draft):
- Evaluation: 6 weeks starting on sign (dedicated trial capacity)
- Acceptance gates: 3 checks — 1) Avg inference latency P95 <= 320ms on 2k qps sample, 2) Quality pass rate >= 92% on benchmark prompt set, 3) Integration stability (no >1% error rate)
- Commitment (monthly tokens / TPM = tokens per month):
  • Month 1 (onboard): 75,000 tokens/month
  • Month 2: 225,000 tokens/month
  • Month 3+: 450,000 tokens/month (steady-state)
- Pricing / credits:
  • Standard list price per 1k tokens: $0.50 (placeholder in draft)
  • 10% discount once monthly commit >= 225k TPM
  • 20% discount once monthly commit >= 450k TPM
  • Early-sign credit: one-time $12,000 credit applied to first invoice if MAP signed within 14 days of final SOW

Notes / open items for procurement: billing cadence (monthly invoicing vs. net-30), security questionnaire (we can provide SOC2 artifacts), and whether you need an escrow/NDA addendum for sensitive pipelines.

Next steps: If the schedule above looks directionally right, Marissa will circulate a redline-friendly MAP and a DocuSign for signature. Also looping Ben to confirm the discount approval flow.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachment: Draft_MAP_NimbleWare_v1.pdf (MAP draft, milestone table, acceptance checklist)

From: Alex Mason <alex@nimbleware.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbleware.com
Date: 2025-08-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + MAP framework

Jonas / Marissa — thank you. Quick clarifications from procurement and engineering: 
1) Procurement: need SOW + billing cadence. Can you confirm whether billing will be monthly in arrears and if net-30 is acceptable? Also include the early-sign credit mechanics in the SOW so we can show it to finance. (Attached: NimbleWare_Eval_SOW.docx)
2) Engineering: can you confirm the ramp enforcement — is the commit a hard minimum (true-up billed) or a soft target with overage rates? We prefer a soft ramp with a committed floor (true-up applies if under-usage) rather than strict chargebacks for short ramp variance.

Also: are the discounts retroactive to the start of steady-state month, or only applied prospectively?

We attached our Eval SOW draft for your reference.

Regards,
Alex
Alex Mason | Head of AI, NimbleWare
Attachment: NimbleWare_Eval_SOW.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mason <alex@nimbleware.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-28T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + MAP framework — proposed edits

Alex — thanks for the SOW and the clear list from procurement. I redlined the MAP and SOW and attached the PDF (MAP_v1_redlines.pdf). Key revisions (summary):

1) Billing cadence & early-sign credit
- Billing: monthly invoicing in arrears; standard net-30 terms unless NimbleWare requires net-45 (we can discuss).
- Early-sign credit: $12,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice; clearly called out in Clause 4.2 of the SOW.

2) Commit enforcement and true-up
- We propose a hybrid approach to reduce risk: committed floor + flexible ramp window:
  • Committed floor = agreed TPM for each month (see schedule below)
  • True-up: if actual usage < committed floor for any given month, NimbleWare is billed at the committed floor rate; if actual usage > committed floor, standard overage rate applies.
  • Grace period: first 60 days after go-live treated as a 20% variance tolerance before true-up enforcement to allow for traffic stabilization.

3) Discount mechanics
- Discounts apply prospectively starting the month a threshold is first met (not retroactive)
- We can offer a one-time reconciliation credit if steady-state is sustained for two consecutive months at the higher tier (operational goodwill).

4) Revised ramp schedule (we shifted quantities slightly to match your expected consumption curve):
  • Month 0 (eval): allocated trial capacity — no billing, acceptance gates apply
  • Month 1 (onboard): 60,000 tokens/month
  • Month 2: 180,000 tokens/month
  • Month 3: 360,000 tokens/month
  • Month 4+: 540,000 tokens/month (steady-state)
Pricing table (excerpt):
  • List $/1k tokens = $0.48
  • >=180k TPM = 12% discount
  • >=360k TPM = 20% discount
  • >=540k TPM = 28% discount

Open items for your team to confirm:
- Accept the hybrid true-up model + 60-day variance tolerance
- Billing cadence (net-30 vs net-45)
- Whether NimbleWare wants the discount to be retroactive for the month the threshold is achieved (we recommended prospectively with a 2-month sustained reconciliation credit)

If these edits look ok, we will prepare a clean SOW + MAP and send a DocuSign envelope (link below) for signatures. Proposed timeline: finalize redlines by Sep 8, sign by Sep 15 to hit production onboarding in early Oct.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/NW-2025-073
DocuSign (preview): https://docusign.com/rooms/abcdef123456

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: MAP_v1_redlines.pdf
